rows.name: Zeotein bag, first order on Meta page

lead: Shoppers compare totals before they compare servings. A one-time bag on the store comes to $122.38 with shipping. Rivals get a first order in for $53 to $78 because they sell 15 to 30 servings and ship free sooner. Your Meta page's first bag, $76.99 delivered, sits right in that range with 30 servings.
note: Zeotein shipping is the average paid by customers who paid it, single-item orders, last 90 days. Rival shipping is the stated fee under their free-shipping line. Ka'Chava's fee is $7.95 per the Nov 10 research, but its site data says up to $10.95. Paleovalley's $7.95 wasn't re-confirmed on Nov 12. Ancient Nutrition ships free from $49.
